channel.title: Taste Daily
channel.description: A daily fifteen-to-twenty-minute conversation on the most interesting things happening at the frontier: AI, compute, space, security, and the craft of building. Two hosts, Hal and Samantha, skip the explainers and go straight to the analysis, with a little wonder at the end. AI-voiced, human-curated taste.

item.title: Pilot
item.description: Episode 0. Banks find AI agents inside customer accounts, day two of Black October and why patching is the real bottleneck, Anthropic's S-1, Elon Musk's 10GW claim, the personal agent wars, whether orthogonality is false, plus a procedural New York in under a megabyte and a 150-megapixel Lagoon Nebula.
